newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares well-traded, Unibanka stable.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares well-traded, Unibanka stable.

text.p: Shares on the Latvian stock market saw active trade on Tuesday although leading stock Unibanka was stable, the bourse said.

Overall market turnover came to 99,354 lats of which Unibanka accounted for 41,774 lats. It was unchanged at 2.30 lats. Fellow official list stock Riga Transport Fleet turned over 20,900 lats and was also stable at one lat.

On the secondary list, most traded was the Daugavpils chain maker on activity of 16,642 lats. It dipped to 1.13 lats from 1.15 lats. Also active was the Salacgriva 95 company on trade of 4,675 lats as it fell to 2.50 lats from 2.55.

Other busy stocks included the Mangali Shipyard on trade of 4,132 lats as it rose by one santime to 40 santimes while the Kaija fish cannery slipped to 1.21 lats from 1.24 lats on turnover of 3,603 lats.
Riga yeast factory saw trade of 3,069 lats and rose slightly to 1.96 lats from 1.95 lats.
The Lode brick factory was unchanged at 1.05 lats on trade of 2,276 lats.
